DV Generic.description: ***READ THIS WHEN CREATING CUSTOM ROLL TABLES*** This is a generic DV table. For a DV table to work, it should be configured as follows: - The Table Name name must begin with "DV ". - Roll Table Formula should be blank & both boxes unchecked - The "Result Type" must be Text - The DV should be in "Result Details" - The weight should be "1" - The Range should be the start distance to end distance, inclusive, in m/yds
